title: More Arrows
description: Gives more arrows for your craft
body:
Arrows can be expensive so this datapack fixes this!(slightly) From the regualr arrow craft you can get 64 arrows instead of 4 and have many more arrows for fighting. 

(Useful for pvp servers and fighting servers)

If there is a version that does not exist please email me here so i know to add it: zwhseton@gmail.com
